sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): leaning forward on his short piston legs, the big fists swinging, the LEGS CHANGING OVER as the pale figure has them
sheets.weapons: HIS ARMS AND FISTS go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the two massive golden arms with their big square fists, as big as in image 1 - pulled back, punching, swinging up or flung out as the pale figure holds them. In Rocket Grab, where the pale figure's arm ends in an EMPTY hexagonal socket (the hand flew off), draw the socket empty, no hand; where the hand is back, draw it. The fists are NOT legs: his two short piston legs with the golden feet carry him. Only him: no steam, no electric sparks or lightning, no chain; the eyes' pink stays inside the eyes.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: the legs EXACTLY as the pale figure has them in this frame: which leg is in front and which behind, which foot is flat on the ground line and which is lifted (image 3: the near leg lighter, the far leg darker). The two legs TAKE TURNS as in the old run: the near leg (the lighter one) and the far leg (the darker one) pass each other, the leg in front changing over the 8 frames - never the same leg in front in every frame (Senna's first run did that, and Talon's: 「走路没有换腿」). His big fists swing down near the ground but are NOT legs: his two short piston legs with the golden feet carry him.

sheets.weapons: HIS ARMS AND FISTS go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the two massive golden arms with their big square fists, as big as in image 1 - pulled back, punching, swinging up or flung out as the pale figure holds them. In Rocket Grab, where the pale figure's arm ends in an EMPTY hexagonal socket (the hand flew off), draw the socket empty, no hand; where the hand is back, draw it. The fists are NOT legs: his two short piston legs with the golden feet carry him. Only him: no steam, no electric sparks or lightning, no chain; the eyes' pink stays inside the eyes.
